domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将整体动力系统分成子结构并协调其响应的方法。
usage_overview: 用于将耦合动力系统分成子系统分别求解，再协调各部分响应。在车辆与轨道、桥梁的耦合分析中，可通过轮轨力和运动关系进行迭代协调。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: The study attempts to simulate the plastic deformation of the reinforced concrete (RC) light rail transit bridge (LRTB) based on the dynamic substructuring method (DSM), which is closely related to the stability problems of the LRV.
